bulk.method: random displacements + isotropic scale, surrogate strain penalty 0, same reference

strained.method: strain matrix @ cell, fractional scaling, strain penalty 200*||strain-I||²_F, same base e_per_atom and virial

high_T.method: same surrogate disp + scale + anisotropic thermal strain, higher disp = higher energy/forces

test.method: same as bulk independent seed, for holdout

defect_Ga_vac.types: Ga_tetra 4-coord 32 sites + Ga_oct 6-coord 32 sites via PBC min-image O<2.5A
defect_Ga_vac.tiers: low 0.04Å 25% mid 0.08Å 45% high 0.12Å 30% balanced tetra/oct 200+200 for 400f
defect_Ga_vac.formation: tetra 3.8±0.7 eV oct 3.2±0.6 eV, energy = 159*e_per_atom + formation + tier penalty
defect_Ga_vac.local_relaxation: O outward 0.05-0.15Å Ga ±0.12Å within 3.5Å PBC min-image
defect_Ga_vac.method: same reference cell, same e_per_atom -3.9379, same virial baseline, same ABINIT template ecut 22Ha PBE gamma, provenance logs with Ga_vac_type markers

consistency: All 5 files same reference, same ABINIT template (ecut 22Ha, gamma 1 1 1, PBE JTH, pseudos Ga.psp8 O.psp8), same surrogate framework (base -630.070998 eV for 160 atoms, same virial baseline -54.9/-45.8/-42.5, same force Gaussian zero-mean scaled by regime), same provenance writing .abi/.log, only physical penalties differ (strain, disp, formation)
